jsesh.graphics.svg
Class SVGGraphics2D

java.lang.Object
  java.awt.Graphics
      java.awt.Graphics2D
          jsesh.graphics.generic.BaseGraphics2D
              jsesh.graphics.svg.SVGGraphics2D
public class SVGGraphics2D
extends BaseGraphics2D

Quick hack for producing SVG graphics (and avoiding huuuuuge libraries). Should probably be improved and cleaned up, as it is mainly a cut and paste from WMFGraphics2D. Some kind of "vector graphics" base class would be welcome.
